integrity: The proof normalizes the support, separates the interior conditional variance, solves the remaining three-level optimization exactly in odds coordinates, and reconstructs all equality and nonattainment cases. Exact-rational computation replays the inequalities and special equality families but does not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The endpoint masses are positive and fixed, and the principal attainable-set statement is for a finite list of distinct ordered atoms.
The theorem optimizes the ratio to the Bhatia--Davis bound while allowing the mean to move; it does not solve the different problem with a prescribed mean.
Older finite-population variance or truncated-moment literature may contain an equivalent endpoint-mass ratio under different terminology.
title: Endpoint masses determine the exact Bhatia–Davis efficiency range
